[quote=tartakum;60330295][b]Coastal Maritime Defence[/b]

The Coastal Maritime Defence and the Maritime Command have long looked for a perfect ship to patrol the shallow coastal beaches of Tartakum. In recent years, pirates have boarded and destroyed small yachts and sailboats on the coast of Tarta. Due to the minimal amount of ships, members, and funding, successful responses are few and far between. The current Coastal defence fleet is made up of small RHIB and Boat teams, and jetskis. The Navy has finally decided to purchase a customized Patrol boat from Nordiheim. The boat is not a standard model and is fully customized. The things modified are the special grenade launcher attached, mountable and demountable machine gun, and removal of the top guns. The most special part is the 2x2 [b]Anti Ship missiles[/b]. These have a range of 75km, and the top machine guns were removed due to allow more targeting and radar equipment.[/quote]

International Defense News Bulletin  
Kestrahaim, The Kingdom of Ekpatanus  17 September 2025, 15:00 local time  

Today, in the capital city of Kestrahaim, senior officials from The Kingdom of Ekpatanus, The Empire of Italian Dutch, and The Armed Republic of Tartakum convened for the formal signing of a tripartite defense agreement. The accord establishes a joint program for the research, design, and development of hypersonic missile systems capable of exceeding Mach 5.  

The signing ceremony took place at the Government Conference Hall in Kestrahaim. Kaiser Sam Michaelidis of Ekpatanus, Emperor Zeno of the Empire of Italian Dutch, and the Commander of the State of the Armed Republic of Tartakum were present to endorse the agreement on behalf of their respective nations.  

According to the official communiqué, the program will be divided into specialized workstreams, with each nation assuming responsibility for a distinct area of research and development. The initiatives stated objective is to enhance collective defense capabilities and maintain a technological edge in the face of evolving global security challenges.  

Implementation of the agreement is scheduled to begin immediately, with the first coordination meeting between technical teams expected within the coming weeks. Further updates on project milestones and testing phases will be released through official defense channels.
